disclaimer: Best-guess operating model — not how B9's systems work today. Edit notes and adjust overlays as Pete and Brenda validate reality. AI overlays are research-based ideas — not commitments. Steps marked with no recommendation are intentionally blank.

processes.name: Marketing / Demand Gen
processes.summary: How clients and talent find B9 — before a specific job exists.

steps.label: Awareness
steps.detail: Website, referrals, WBENC/NMSDC listings, partnerships, social presence.

ai.label: Draft social posts & review responses
ai.idea: Brenda's lane — not a Pete Phase 1 pilot. Approve everything before publish.

steps.label: Inbound interest
steps.detail: Request a Quote, Become a Model, email, or RFP portal alert.

ai.label: Tag inbound type & draft first response
ai.idea: Same inbox pilot as Comms → Client email — primary entry for quote/model traffic.

steps.label: Initial routing
steps.detail: Someone decides client vs talent vs spam; assigns to coordinator or Brenda.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Routing is a judgment call. Inbox pilot (ROI-01) helps upstream — not a separate project.

steps.label: Dormant re-engagement
steps.detail: Periodic outreach to past clients who haven't booked recently.

ai.label: Personalized win-back draft emails
ai.idea: Needs a client list export (CRM or spreadsheet) — human sends.

processes.name: Discovery / Scoping
processes.summary: First 24–72 hours after a client inquiry — understand the ask.

steps.label: Inquiry logged
steps.detail: Email or call captured; job folder or thread started (often informal).

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Mostly discipline (folder, subject line, owner). Inbox pilot creates the thread — don't bolt on a second tool.

steps.label: Qualify
steps.detail: Budget, dates, market, headcount, brand fit — go/no-go judgment.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Go/no-go stays human. Optional: ask AI to summarize the email thread during inbox pilot — not a new use case.

steps.label: Brief intake
steps.detail: Collect requirements, venue, dress code, hours, special asks — lots of back-and-forth.

ai.label: Draft replies while gathering requirements
ai.idea: Same inbox pilot — measurable response-time win in 30 days.

steps.label: Internal handoff
steps.detail: Brief summarized for quoting and casting — often retyped from email.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Fix handoff format after quote pilot (ROI-02) produces a structured brief — not before.

steps.label: Hand off to quote
steps.detail: Coordinator or Brenda triggers proposal workflow when scope is clear.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Workflow notification is Phase 2 wiring (Pete's connector interest) — after one assist pilot proves the handoff.

processes.name: Proposal / Quote / Pricing
processes.summary: Turn the brief into a priced offer the client can approve.

steps.label: Rate lookup
steps.detail: Find rates, past similar jobs, margin rules — may live in head, sheets, or docs.

ai.label: Surface rate card lines & similar past quotes
ai.idea: Prerequisite: one rate-card doc in Drive the team trusts.

steps.label: Scope & line items
steps.detail: Roles, counts, hours, travel, overtime, brand training needs.

ai.label: Structured quote draft from brief + rate card
ai.idea: Second Phase 1 pilot candidate — ties directly to 3–5 day quote turnaround baseline.

steps.label: RFP / procurement path
steps.detail: If enterprise: capability deck, diverse-spend narrative, formal response.

ai.label: RFP & capability deck drafts
ai.idea: Phase 2 — only if Brenda confirms RFP is material % of pipeline.

steps.label: Contract review
steps.detail: Client paper or B9 template — insurance, cancellation, payment terms.

ai.label: Flag risky contract clauses
ai.idea: Counsel still decides — AI highlights, doesn't approve.

steps.label: Send & negotiate
steps.detail: Human sends; revisions until signed or lost.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Negotiation is relationship-heavy. Inbox pilot can draft revision emails if needed — not a separate initiative.

processes.name: Talent Sourcing / Vetting
processes.summary: Parallel pipeline — how 1099 talent enters and stays on the roster.

steps.label: Attract applicants
steps.detail: Become a Model, referrals, past talent, market-specific recruiting.

ai.label: Role description & recruiting post drafts
ai.idea: Compliance redesign required — no automated screening or ranking.

steps.label: Screen & vet
steps.detail: Photos, experience, market fit, references — human judgment heavy.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Screening stays human. AI must not score or filter applicants — counsel risk.

steps.label: Onboard & profile
steps.detail: Paperwork, W-9, StaffConnect profile, availability, markets served.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Checklists and forms — low ROI until applicant volume justifies automation.

steps.label: Roster maintenance
steps.detail: Keep profiles current; mark inactive; note preferences and reliability informally.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Depends on a real roster system of record. B9 may be on spreadsheets — validate before any AI here.

processes.name: Casting / Matching / Booking
processes.summary: Match approved talent to a booked job — client may weigh in.

steps.label: Parse job requirements
steps.detail: Roles, look, skills, languages, dress from client brief.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Structured brief should come from quote/scoping work — not a separate casting AI project.

steps.label: Search roster
steps.detail: Filter by market, availability, past performance — often manual.

ai.label: Suggest filters — human selects final talent
ai.idea: High compliance risk in NYC/IL/CA — counsel before talent-facing matching.

steps.label: Conflict check
steps.detail: Double-bookings, travel time, back-to-back events.

ai.label: Flag scheduling conflicts
ai.idea: Strong Phase 1 candidate after inbox/quote pilots — needs calendar/roster export.

steps.label: Offer & confirm
steps.detail: Outreach to talent; accept/decline; client approval if needed.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Phase 1: shared message templates (see Comms). Personal phones send manually — no bot yet.

steps.label: Booking locked
steps.detail: StaffConnect or equivalent updated; talent and client notified.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: System update + notifications — Phase 2 wiring after messaging templates are proven.

processes.name: Pre-Event Prep / Logistics
processes.summary: The week before — everything talent and client need on the ground.

steps.label: Call sheet & logistics
steps.detail: Times, location, parking, contact, dress, materials.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Standard call-sheet template may be enough. Revisit after brief/quote structure is stable.

steps.label: Brand / role briefing
steps.detail: Talking points, do's and don'ts, client-specific training.

ai.label: Voluntary brand familiarization quizzes
ai.idea: Not mandatory employment training — compliance redesign required.

steps.label: COI & compliance docs
steps.detail: Insurance certificates, venue requirements, contracts filed.

ai.label: Check COI & venue requirements against checklist
ai.idea: Only valuable if enterprise venues send non-standard requirements often.

steps.label: Talent confirmation blast
steps.detail: Reminders; last-minute subs if someone drops.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Use shared text templates (Comms overlay) — coordinators send from personal phones today.

steps.label: Client prep touchpoint
steps.detail: Final headcount, schedule tweaks, emergency contacts.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Short client email — covered by inbox pilot if needed, not a separate use case.

processes.name: Event Day / Execution
processes.summary: Real-time coordination — where reputations are won or lost.

steps.label: Check-in
steps.detail: Talent arrives; sign-in; issue materials; confirm roles.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Real-time floor work — paper roster or simple app beats AI here.

steps.label: Run of show
steps.detail: Supervise floor; client liaison; handle surprises.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Coordinator leadership on site — AI doesn't help in the moment.

steps.label: Issue & recovery
steps.detail: No-shows, late arrivals, wardrobe, attitude — escalate and replace.

ai.label: Standby blast & replacement workflow
ai.idea: Phase 2 — after messaging templates and counsel review on talent comms.

steps.label: Timesheets & notes
steps.detail: Hours captured; incident notes for recap and payroll.

ai.label: Structure bullet notes for recap & payroll
ai.idea: Feeds the recap pilot — capture on phone, draft recap next day.

steps.label: Wrap & debrief
steps.detail: Quick internal what-went-well; flag client follow-ups.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Verbal debrief is fine — optional bullets feed recap (see timesheets step).

processes.name: Post-Event / Recap
processes.summary: Close the loop with client and talent while memory is fresh.

steps.label: Collect artifacts
steps.detail: Photos, attendance, client feedback, talent feedback, expenses.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Operational checklist — not an AI problem until volume forces it.

steps.label: Draft recap
steps.detail: Client-facing summary — often delayed when team is busy.

ai.label: Recap draft from bullet notes
ai.idea: Third Phase 1 candidate after inbox & quotes — recap within 48 hours.

steps.label: Rich recap (optional)
steps.detail: Photo highlights, social-ready snippets for premium clients.

ai.label: Multimodal recap with photo highlights
ai.idea: Phase 2 premium upsell — after text recap pilot works.

steps.label: Send & archive
steps.detail: Human sends to client; files stored for renewals and disputes.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Human sends and files — the AI value is in drafting (previous step).

steps.label: Internal learnings
steps.detail: Update talent notes; flag upsell or risk for account team.

ai.label: Surface expansion signals from email threads
ai.idea: Phase 2 — needs enough retained clients and email history to matter.

processes.name: Finance / Invoicing / Payroll
processes.summary: Get paid, pay talent, stay cash-flow sane.

steps.label: Timesheet → invoice
steps.detail: Client billing from event hours and agreed rates.

ai.label: Cross-check invoice lines vs timesheets & quote
ai.idea: Brenda/finance lane — strong after event ops capture hours consistently.

steps.label: Talent payroll
steps.detail: 1099 payments; expense reimbursements; W-2 where applicable.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: QBO payroll process — validate with finance before adding AI layer.

steps.label: Reconciliation
steps.detail: Match invoices to timesheets and contracts.

ai.label: Invoice vs timesheet audit
ai.idea: Same ROI-12 pattern as billing — one finance pilot, not two projects.

steps.label: AR & collections
steps.detail: Follow up on late pay; cash timing matters for payroll.

ai.label: Weekly cash-flow forecast from QBO exports
ai.idea: Leadership visibility — weekly routine, not one-off analysis.

steps.label: Expense capture
steps.detail: Receipts, travel, misc — often a shoebox until month-end.

ai.label: Organize receipts for accounting
ai.idea: Simple photo → categorized export — finance validates.

processes.name: Comms & channels
processes.summary: How people actually message — spans every phase.

steps.label: Client email
steps.detail: Primary channel for quotes, changes, recaps.

ai.label: Triage, draft, and file client threads
ai.idea: Primary Phase 1 pilot — pick this OR quotes, not both in first 30 days.

steps.label: Talent text / WhatsApp
steps.detail: Shift offers, reminders, day-of — often personal phones today.

ai.label: Shared message template library (Phase 1)
ai.idea: Not a bot — approved templates in ChatGPT Teams or a doc. ~20 hrs/week roster comms is the pain to validate.

steps.label: StaffConnect / ops hub
steps.detail: Bookings, profiles, availability — system of record when used consistently.

ai.label: No standalone recommendation
ai.idea: Stack survey says spreadsheets today — confirm actual ops hub before any AI on roster data.

steps.label: Talent FAQ
steps.detail: Repeat questions on pay, location, what to wear.

ai.label: Supportive FAQ bot — opt-in, human escalation
ai.idea: Phase 2 — counsel + talent consent. Templates (k2) come first.

steps.label: Glue & automation
steps.detail: Wire channel to trigger (Zapier, Twilio, API) — after one path is proven.

ai.label: Event triggers → drafted messages
ai.idea: Pete's wiring interest — Phase 2 after assist-first pilots prove one path.
